en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from a man from salma Baya’a Al Qalanasy who said,

‘I was in the presence of Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> when Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> came over to him<sup>asws</sup>. So Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O my<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup>! Will you not clean your<sup>asws</sup> shirt?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> went, and we thought that something had hit his<sup>asws</sup> clothes. So he<sup>asws</sup> returned and said: ‘It is like this’. So we said, ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Make us to be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>, what is the matter with his<sup>asws</sup> shirt?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘His<sup>asws</sup> shirt was long and I<sup>asws</sup> instructed him<sup>asws</sup> that he<sup>asws</sup> should shorten (it).
Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [74:4] And your garments do purify’.
en.sarwar: 10. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Muhammad ibn Ali from a man from Salmah Bayya’ al-Qalanis who has said the following:

“I once was with abu Ja‘far, when abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, came. Abu Ja‘far, said, ‘You must cleanse your shirt.’ He left and we thought his shirt might have come in contact with something unclean. He came back and he (the Imam) said, ‘It just is as it was.’ We then asked saying, ‘We pray to Allah to keep our souls in service for your cause, what is wrong with his shirt?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘His shirt is long and I commanded him to shorten it;
because Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, has said, ‘. . . and cleanse (shorten) your clothes.’ [74:4]”
